zh: 已配对的人离队后，剩下的女生仍然保持原来的先后顺序，所以每个男生要找的“前面最近的未配对女生”，总是最后一个还没配对的女生。
这正是后进先出：女生按出现顺序入栈，男生出现时弹出栈顶。
从左到右扫描：遇到 0 就把她的编号（从 1 开始）压栈；遇到 1 时栈非空就弹出栈顶作为配对，栈空则记录 −1。按男生出现顺序空格分隔输出，没有男生时输出空行。
en: After matched people leave, the remaining girls keep their original order, so the nearest unmatched girl ahead of a boy is always the most recent unmatched girl.
That is last-in, first-out: push girls in order of appearance and pop the top when a boy appears.

Scan left to right: on 0 push her 1-based index; on 1 pop the top as his partner if the stack is non-empty, otherwise record −1. Print the results in the order the boys appear, separated by spaces, or an empty line if there are no boys.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Keep the indices of unmatched girls on a stack. When a boy comes, pop the top; if there is no girl, output -1.

## Proof of correctness

The girls still in line after people leave keep their original order, so the nearest unmatched girl ahead is exactly the top of the stack. Each girl is pushed and popped only once, and processing boy by boy gives all the pairings.

## Complexity

O(N) time, O(N) space.
